scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Guest Book starts T4's authenticated shared six-minute timer
Late join restores actual scroll classifications and exact deadline
Wrong proof style charges its authenticated sender despite a forged actor field
Replayed proof submission cannot charge another mistake
Guest snapshot cannot forge proof completion
Teammate corrects the same scrolls and shares the proof-style result
T4 remains reserved between challenges
Next challenge keeps four original scrolls and the same running clock
Guest cannot steal a manuscript carried by a teammate
Live master handoff retains solved work, carried manuscript and deadline
Departure returns held scrolls while preserving reservation and mistake identity
Timeout retains classifications and attributes one mistake to the current activator
Expired T4 cannot be exchanged for another topic
Guest retry keeps current manuscripts and starts a fresh attempt
Only the captured player loses proof interaction authority
Captured guest cannot pick a nearby unheld manuscript
Photon challenge 2 shares its accepted proof and progress
Photon challenge 3 shares its accepted proof and progress
Photon challenge 4 shares its accepted proof and progress
Photon challenge 5 shares its accepted proof and progress
All five networked proof challenges freeze time and unlock the next topic
T4 network play preserves every other topic's progress and timer
